class.name: SpringDamper
class.brief_description: Springy, frame-rate independent motion toward a target that can overshoot and wobble.
class.description:
SpringDamper moves a value toward a target like a damped spring. It uses the exact solution of a damped harmonic oscillator, so it behaves the same at any frame rate and stays stable with large [code]delta[/code] values. Unlike [SmoothDamp], it can overshoot, which suits weapon recoil, UI bounce, hanging props and procedural camera sway. [codeblock] var spring := SpringDamper.new() spring.frequency = 3.0 spring.damping_ratio = 0.4
func _process(delta): position = spring.step(position, target.position, delta) [/codeblock] Floats, [Vector2], [Vector3] and [Vector4] are supported. Use one SpringDamper per value, since each keeps its own velocity.

method.name: add_impulse
method.description: Adds [param impulse] to the current velocity, for example to kick a camera when the player is hit. The impulse must have the same type as the value being smoothed.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears the stored velocity. Call this after teleporting the smoothed value.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the spring by [param delta] seconds and returns the new value. [member velocity] is updated.

members.member: How quickly oscillation dies out. [code]1.0[/code] is critically damped (no overshoot, fastest settling), values below [code]1.0[/code] bounce, values above [code]1.0[/code] approach the target more slowly. [code]0.0[/code] oscillates forever.
Natural frequency of the spring in hertz. Higher values make it stiffer and faster.
Current velocity of the smoothed value, in units per second.
